meta.title: Suggest API | gstudio1.com
meta.description: Docs for a free JSON API that returns autocomplete suggestions from Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon, Rakuten, Yahoo! and DuckDuckGo, expanded with A–Z, 0–9 and Japanese kana.
intro: A JSON API that returns expanded autocomplete suggestions from Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon, eBay, Shopee and DuckDuckGo, plus regional engines (Baidu, Yandex, Naver, Daum, Yahoo!, Rakuten), in 50 languages with selectable countries. Each keyword is expanded with a space, the language's own letters (for example ä ö ü ß in German, а–я in Russian, 가 나 다 in Korean, ก–ฮ in Thai, क–ह in Hindi, あ–ん in Japanese), A–Z and 0–9. Start on the free plan (pricing).
auth.p: An API key is required. Log in and issue a key from “API” in the user menu. Send it with every request.
auth.note: Use the key from your server only. If you embed it in browser JavaScript, other people can use it.
suggest.p: Set {source} to one of the following.
src.amazon: Amazon suggestions from the marketplace you pick with lang and country (Amazon.com, Amazon.co.uk, Amazon.de, Amazon.co.jp and more)
src.ebay: eBay suggestions from the site you pick with lang and country (ebay.com, ebay.co.uk, ebay.de, ebay.fr and more; en, de, fr, it, es, nl, pl)
src.shopee: Shopee suggestions from the site you pick with lang and country (shopee.tw, shopee.sg, shopee.com.my, shopee.ph, shopee.co.id, shopee.vn, shopee.co.th, shopee.com.br and more; zh-tw, en, ms, fil, id, vi, th, pt)
src.yahoo: Yahoo! JAPAN search suggestions (Japan only) · zh-tw: Yahoo奇摩 (Yahoo! Taiwan)
src.duckduckgo: DuckDuckGo suggestions (lang=ja returns suggestions for Japan)
param.q: Keyword (1–60 characters). Full-width/half-width characters, letter case and spaces are normalized.
param.lang: ja (the default, kept for existing clients; set it explicitly), en, ru, ko, zh and the other site language codes (50 in all). ja adds the kana expansion (nihongo); other languages add a space plus their own letters (native). en has neither.
async.p: Fetching a keyword that is not cached yet takes tens of seconds, so the API first returns 202 and queues it. Send the same request again after retry_after_seconds; once the data is ready you get 200 with the results. Results are cached for 7 days. After they expire, the old data is returned with "stale": true while it is being refreshed. The cache is separate for each combination of source, q and lang.
other.usage: Usage of your key over the last 30 days and your plan limits (authentication required)
other.status: Queue depth and worker status (no authentication)
limits.newkw_note: Counted per source. Keywords that are already cached do not count.
limits.p: When a limit is exceeded the API returns 429 with Retry-After. Every response includes X-RateLimit-Limit / Remaining / Reset and X-Daily-Limit / X-Daily-Remaining.
err.400: Invalid parameter (including a source not offered for that language)
err.502: Fetch failed (you can retry after one hour)
contact.p: For higher limits, commercial use or bug reports, message the operator (Yuki Nakazawa) directly on Telegram or X. Replies in English or Japanese.
notes.1: The free plan's limits may change without notice. For paid plans see the pricing page.
notes.2: The data is based on the public suggestion responses of each service. Accuracy and continuity (SLA) are not guaranteed.
param.country: Country / market within the language (optional, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). en: us (default), gb, ca, au, in, ie, nz, sg, za, ph; es: es, mx, ar, co, cl, pe, us; pt: br, pt; fr: fr, ca, be, ch; de: de, at, ch; zh-tw: tw, hk; and more. Applies to Amazon (marketplace), Bing, DuckDuckGo, Google and YouTube. Amazon, Bing and DuckDuckGo follow the country closely; Google and YouTube are localized too but can still reflect where the request is sent from.
